intuition: Anagrams have the same character counts, so a canonical representation of those counts can group words together.

brute_force.approach: For each word, compare its sorted characters against the representative of each existing group.

optimal.approach: Use the tuple of 26 lowercase-letter counts as a dictionary key and append each word to that key's group.

edge_cases: An empty string forms a valid one-word group.
Repeated letters must be represented by their counts, not just their presence.
The order of groups and words within groups is not significant.
